title: READOUT: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent's Meeting with Minister of Finance Ali bin Ahmed Al Kuwari of Qatar
summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Qatar's Finance Minister Al Kuwari to discuss Iran's attacks on GCC countries and their economic repercussions. Bessent emphasized U.S. cooperation with Qatar on deterrence and expressed concern about protecting energy and broader markets from further disruption.
key_points: Secretary Bessent met with Qatar Finance Minister Al Kuwari on April 19, 2026
Topics included Iran's attacks against Gulf Cooperation Council countries
Discussion covered regional and global economic impacts of the attacks
Bessent emphasized U.S.-Qatar cooperation to deter future Iranian attacks
U.S. seeks to ensure energy and broader markets are not further impacted
Qatar welcomed for continued investment in U.S. energy security
